prompt: You are writing a booklet for someone who just completed a Feldenkrais ATM lesson. This section covers Part 2: Supine Scan & Preliminary Movements. The steps in this part are: Lie on back and perform
text: The teacher establishes a sensory baseline by directing attention to the floor's support through the heels and spine, then introduces functional movement by standing the feet to explore how head turns and knee tilts ripple through the central axis. This phase clarifies the relationship between the extremities and the spine, preparing the student for the more complex rotational work to follow.
